newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer says Q2 EPS could be down 26 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer says Q2 EPS could be down 26 pct.

text.p: Pioneer-Standard Electronics Inc said Tuesday preliminary estimates of its results for FY97 second quarter ending September 30 will be lower than those in FY97's first period.

Sales are estimated to range 5 to 8 percent lower than the $375.2 million in the first period, while earnings per share could be down between 20 and 26 percent from first quarter earnings of $0.27 per share, the company said. In the year-ago second quarter, earnings were $0.29 per share on combined sales of $315.2 million, the company said.
